report.summary: Analyzed daedalus/eval/tasks.py chunk 1 of 3: module docstring describing task formats, resolve_task_repo function, and is_correctness_task function.
risks: resolve_task_repo | medium | Raises ValueError for unknown repo labels; callers must handle or else crash. | Ensure all callers catch ValueError.

is_correctness_task | low | Only checks for keys 'fail_to_pass' or 'pass_to_pass'; a task with both but also 'must_include' would be misidentified. | Verify that correctness tasks never have 'must_include'.

module docstring | low | Claims correctness tasks live in their own store and never enter harness.all_tasks(); uncheckable in this chunk. | Check correctness.py for DEFAULT_CORPUS_PATH and harness.all_tasks().

handoff.purpose: Define task formats, resolve_task_repo, and is_correctness_task for distillation eval.

symbols.name: resolve_task_repo
symbols.note: Maps repo label to absolute path; raises ValueError if unresolved.

symbols.name: is_correctness_task
symbols.note: Returns True if task has 'fail_to_pass' or 'pass_to_pass' keys.

symbols.name: CORRECTNESS_KEYS
symbols.note: Tuple of keys that indicate a correctness task.

symbols.name: AGENT_ENV_ROOT
symbols.note: Absolute path to agent_env repo root (parents[2] of this file).

claims.text: a label is only listed if a competent answer about the target genuinely needs it AND it is a real dependency or caller in the neighborhood.
claims.why: No task data provided in this chunk to verify label selection criteria.

claims.text: must_include items are matched as substrings against the slice text.
claims.why: Scoring logic not present in this chunk.

claims.text: For a symbol target the slice is 1-hop (the focus symbol's direct callees/callers), so we only label symbols reachable within that hop -- we do NOT claim transitive callees-of-callees are present when they are not.
claims.why: Slice construction not shown in this chunk.

claims.text: hand_reachable -- a human picked the label AND verified it reachable by running semantic_slice (see daedalus.eval.harness). This is CIRCULAR: the slicer chose what it is graded on. Every task below is this provenance today.
claims.why: No task list present to verify provenance values.

claims.text: Recall computed over hand_reachable tasks is an upper bound / sanity check, NOT independent proof the slicer works -- report.py says so on every render, and harness.run_tier1 never blends it with the other provenances into one number.
claims.why: Referenced report.py and harness.run_tier1 not in this chunk.

claims.text: independent_diff -- labels derived from what an on-disk diff LITERALLY changed, with no graph walk involved. Independent of the slicer.
claims.why: No code implementing this provenance present.

claims.text: temporal_churn -- labels derived from git co-change (files that change together), surfacing edges the static import graph doesn't have. Independent of the slicer.
claims.why: No code implementing this provenance present.

claims.text: primary tasks count toward any go/no-go recall number.
claims.why: No task list or scoring logic present.

claims.text: quarantine tasks are minted but not yet confirmed -- harness.run_tier1 excludes them from every headline/aggregate and reports them separately so the labelling flywheel stays observable instead of silently inflating (or deflating) the real number.
claims.why: Referenced harness.run_tier1 not in this chunk.

claims.text: a correctness task carries no must_include, so scoring one with harness._recall would return the vacuous 1.0 -- a task that cannot fail, silently inflating the very number the tier machinery exists to keep honest.
claims.why: Referenced harness._recall not in this chunk.

claims.text: is_correctness_task below is the single predicate that decides, and harness.eval_task_tier1/eval_task_arms refuse such a task loudly (an ERRORED row, which run_gate reports and fails on for a primary tier) instead of grading it.
claims.why: Referenced harness functions not in this chunk.

claims.text: Correctness tasks live in their own store (correctness.DEFAULT_CORPUS_PATH) and never enter harness.all_tasks().
claims.why: Referenced correctness module and harness.all_tasks() not in this chunk.

claims.text: agent_env repo root == parents[2] of this file (daedalus/eval/tasks.py).
claims.why: AGENT_ENV_ROOT is defined as Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], which matches the claim.

claims.text: Map a task's repo label to an absolute repo root.
claims.why: Function returns absolute path as described.

claims.text: True iff task uses the FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS format.
claims.why: Function returns True if task has 'fail_to_pass' or 'pass_to_pass' keys.

observations.what: Module docstring is extensive and references many external components not present in this chunk.
resolve_task_repo handles 'agent_env', absolute paths, and registered project names; raises ValueError for unknown labels.
is_correctness_task checks for any of CORRECTNESS_KEYS; a task with both fail_to_pass and pass_to_pass but also must_include would be misclassified.
